subject: Dorbo
fact: Dorbo is the leader of the mining coalition who explained that ooze infestations had been hindering both mining operations and the construction of housing for the community.
source_quote: Dorbo, leader of the mining coalition, explained that ooze infestations had been hindering both mining operations and the construction of housing for the community.

subject: Senni
fact: Senni, representing the non-mining population, confronted Dorbo about his failure to adequately address the ooze problem.
source_quote: Senni, representing the non-mining population, confronted him about his failure to adequately address the problem.

subject: Gold Whisker clan
fact: The Gold Whisker clan is a group Chief Dorbo suspected of being wererats and refused to cooperate with.
source_quote: The conversation also revealed tensions regarding the Gold Whisker clan—a group Chief Dorbo suspected of being wererats and refused to cooperate with.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is a ghost who had been traveling with the party; Buppido had killed Pelek.
source_quote: Before embarking on their quest, the party decided to honor a promise they had made to Pelek, a ghost who had been traveling with them. Buppido had killed Pelek.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido had killed Pelek.
source_quote: Buppido had killed Pelek.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had carried Pelek's bones in the hope of finding a proper resting place.
source_quote: Grygum had carried Pelek's bones in the hope of finding a proper resting place.

subject: cemetery adjacent to the Temple of the Ruby in the Rough
fact: A guard directed the party to the cemetery adjacent to the Temple of the Ruby in the Rough, dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller, the Svirfneblin god of deep earthen nature.
source_quote: A guard directed them to the cemetery adjacent to the Temple of the Ruby in the Rough, dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller, the Svirfneblin god of deep earthen nature.

subject: Glyphic Shroomlight
fact: Glyphic Shroomlight is a priest who was initially hesitant to inter the bones of someone he didn't know.
source_quote: At the temple, they met Glyphic Shroomlight, a priest who was initially hesitant to inter the bones of someone he didn't know.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an intelligent gelatinous cube companion who was asked to remain upstairs to avoid any accidents.
source_quote: asking only that Glabbagool, their intelligent gelatinous cube companion, remain upstairs to avoid any accidents.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum found a quiet corner and carefully interred Pelek's bones, performing a dragon-themed ritual and planting a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.
source_quote: In the catacombs, Grygum found a quiet corner and carefully interred Pelek's bones, performing a dragon-themed ritual and planting a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek expressed profound relief and gratitude, having feared he would be lost forever, tormenting people for eternity.
source_quote: Pelek expressed profound relief and gratitude, having feared he would be lost forever, tormenting people for eternity.

subject: Borough Warden Jadger
fact: Borough Warden Jadger is a three-foot-tall spirit who had once defended Blingdenstone against the Drow and countless other threats.
source_quote: Almost immediately, another ghost appeared—Borough Warden Jadger, a three-foot-tall spirit who had once defended Blingdenstone against the Drow and countless other threats.

subject: Borough Warden Jadger
fact: Jadger was working to re-establish the Borough Wardens and was secretly training young gnomes for this purpose.
source_quote: Jadger explained that he was working to re-establish the Borough Wardens and was secretly training young gnomes for this purpose.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mentioned a possible connection to Juiblex.
source_quote: When Zalthir mentioned a possible connection to Juiblex, Jadger grew thoughtful and offered a clarification in exchange for Zalthir demonstrating a monk technique he could teach to his young trainees.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir performed an impressive martial display.
source_quote: After Zalthir performed an impressive martial display, Jadger explained the difference between devils and demons.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger explained the difference between devils and demons: devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.
source_quote: Jadger explained the difference between devils and demons: devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.

subject: Jadger
fact: Jadger advised the party to search for someone or something that was motivating the oozes, suggesting that a demon had likely granted power to an intermediate agent.
source_quote: He advised the party to search for someone or something that was motivating the oozes, suggesting that a demon had likely granted power to an intermediate agent.

subject: Trader's Grotto
fact: The Trader's Grotto is Blingdenstone's bustling central market.
source_quote: With Jadger's counsel in mind, the party made their way to the Trader's Grotto, Blingdenstone's bustling central market.

subject: Sergeant
fact: A sergeant guided them through the cavern, proudly explaining that fungi had once grown there until a medusa's spell turned them to stone centuries ago.
source_quote: A sergeant guided them through the cavern, proudly explaining that fungi had once grown there until a medusa's spell turned them to stone centuries ago.

subject: petrified fungi
fact: Merchants had set up makeshift stalls among the petrified fungi, hawking their wares and bartering with one another.
source_quote: Merchants had set up makeshift stalls among the petrified fungi, hawking their wares and bartering with one another.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool tried his best to explain he was not a threat.
source_quote: As the party explored, they noticed the gnomes eyeing Glabbagool with suspicion, though he tried his best to explain he was not a threat.

subject: non-sentient gelatinous cubes
fact: Several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks, causing mass panic among the merchants.
source_quote: Suddenly, several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks, causing mass panic among the merchants.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool protested that these mindless creatures were giving intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name.
source_quote: Glabbagool protested that these mindless creatures were giving intelligent gelatinous cubes a bad name.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool advised the party to avoid being engulfed, to use acid protection if they had any, and to pull out anyone who got trapped as quickly as possible.
source_quote: He quickly advised the party to avoid being engulfed, to use acid protection if they had any, and to pull out anyone who got trapped as quickly as possible.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir rushed forward to strike one of the cubes with powerful blows before retreating to safety.
source_quote: Zalthir rushing forward to strike one of the cubes with powerful blows before retreating to safety.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin kept his distance, hurling darts at the creatures.
source_quote: Thorin kept his distance, hurling darts at the creatures.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.
source_quote: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz carefully positioned himself and unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others while avoiding the merchant stalls.
source_quote: Daz carefully positioned himself and unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others while avoiding the merchant stalls.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands that allowed him to strike from a distance.
source_quote: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands that allowed him to strike from a distance.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asked in wonder if Zalthir was an ooze.
source_quote: prompting Glabbagool to ask in wonder if he was an ooze.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir replied that he was merely an aspiring ooze.
source_quote: Zalthir replied that he was merely an aspiring ooze, which seemed to satisfy the curious cube.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.
source_quote: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.

subject: one remaining gelatinous cube
fact: Only one cube remained, reduced to a single hit point, and Zalthir delivered the killing blow.
source_quote: By the time the smoke cleared, only one cube remained, reduced to a single hit point, and Zalthir delivered the killing blow.
